target.title: fix(discord): strip attachments >10MB before send to prevent HTTP 413 silent message loss (fixes #99021)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #99021.

When an agent reply includes a media attachment larger than Discord's bot upload limit (10 MB), the entire outbound reply (text AND attachment) is rejected with HTTP 413 and silently lost. The run is logged as `outcome=completed`, no retry occurs, and the user sees the agent as simply not responding.

## Changes Made

- `extensions/discord/src/send.shared.ts`: Added `DISCORD_BOT_ATTACHMENT_LIMIT_BYTES = 10MB` constant and pre-flight size check in `sendDiscordMedia`. When attachment exceeds 10MB, it is stripped and text-only fallback is sent instead.
- `extensions/discord/src/send.outbound.ts`: Lowered `DEFAULT_DISCORD_MEDIA_MAX_MB` from 100 to 10 to match Discord's actual bot limit.
- `extensions/discord/src/send.sends-basic-channel-messages.test.ts`: Added regression test for oversized media.

## Evidence

### Real Discord API proof (live bot, redacted)

```
================================================
 DISCORD 413 FIX — REAL API VERIFICATION
 Time: 2026-07-02T11:02:36+00:00
 Host: LIN-66D8BD4EA2C
================================================

BEFORE FIX: 11MB attachment via Discord API
  HTTP 413 — DISCARDED (message + attachment both lost)

AFTER FIX: Size check → text delivered, no attachment
  HTTP: 201
  Message ID: 1522195816796782666
  Content: "Check this video\n\n_Attachment exceeds Discord's 10 MB limit..."
  Attachments: 0
  ✅ TEXT DELIVERED, no attachment lost
```

### Unit tests (45/45 passed)
```
✓ strips oversized media >10MB and sends text-only fallback (#99021)
✓ uploads media attachments
✓ uses configured discord mediaMaxMb for uploads
✓ 45 passed
```

- **Co-Authored-By**: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
- **Human confirmed understanding**: Yes
